chunks: (Remember) Job when he called to his Lord: "I am afflicted with distress, and You are the most compassionate of all."

key_terms.أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ: The most compassionate of the compassionate ones, a divine attribute emphasizing God's mercy
key_terms.أَيُّوبَ: Job (peace be upon him), a prophet known for his patience during severe trials

ai.seo_question: What was the supplication of Prophet Job (Ayyub) when he faced affliction?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the Prophet Job’s (Ayyub) transition from enduring severe trials to invoking divine mercy, emphasizing that his plea was not merely for relief but for the restoration of his spiritual and physical wholeness. The attribute 'Arham al-Rahimin' (Most Compassionate of the Compassionate) underscores the Shia understanding of God’s mercy as an active, responsive force that answers the sincere supplications of the righteous during times of affliction.
